form1.title: Bachelor 3 and Master's in Web Development
form1.desc: Specialized training in web development, covering front-end and back-end technologies. This course provides mastery of modern programming languages as well as frameworks used in the industry.
form1.positive1: Degree recognized by the Ministry of Labor and companies
form1.positive2: The program offers a good foundation in front-end and back-end development, with practical projects and appreciated professional support.
form1.positive3: Many practical projects that allow students to develop the acquired knowledge fairly quickly
form1.negative1: However, interdisciplinary projects (Ydays) lack clarity and guidance, and some courses could be more in-depth with more sessions.

form2.title: BTS SIO option SLAM
form2.desc: The BTS Services Informatiques aux Organisations (SIO) option Solutions Logicielles et Applications Métiers (SLAM) trains in the skills required to develop software solutions adapted to business needs.
form2.positive1: Solid training with a good balance of theory and practice
form2.positive2: Internship in a company providing real experience
form2.positive3: Good foundation for working in software development
form2.negative1: Lack of advanced specialization on some topics, especially regarding Front-End and Frameworks in general
form2.negative2: Relatively short and somewhat outdated program with certain aspects needing review

form3.title: General Baccalaureate, Mathematics and Computer Science Specialty
form3.desc: The General Baccalaureate with specialties in Mathematics and Computer Science (NSI) provides a solid foundation in mathematics. For IT, it is more of an introduction to the field with some basic programming concepts but mainly oriented towards mathematical logic and computer science. A good start to pursue studies in web or software development.
form3.positive1: Good preparation for computer science studies
form3.positive2: A fairly complete curriculum for a start
form3.positive3: Deepening of scientific and logical concepts
form3.negative1: Demanding curriculum requiring practice and reflection
form3.negative2: Lack of practical depth in computer projects and lack of diversification in computer science fields (cybersecurity, data, etc.)
form3.school: Jean Renou High School La Réole
